name: things-local
description: Private, dependency-free bridge between Claude and Things 3 on this Mac.
long_description: Lets Claude read, search and edit Things 3 using only Apple's built-in automation and Things' official things:/// URL scheme. One readable file, no third-party packages, no network access, and no permanent deletes. All changes go through Things' official interfaces; checklists, headings, search/filtering and tag usage are read from the Things database in read-only mode.

things_auth_token.title: Things URL auth token (optional)
things_auth_token.description: Unlocks evening and reminder-time scheduling, checklist edits, heading moves and deadline clearing on existing to-dos. In Things: Settings → General → Enable Things URLs → Manage.
